title: The simultaneous system open base-change isomorphism localizes to the intrinsic one
statement: For any sequence C of commutative rings and transitions τ and any cartesian square a,b,i,p with b,i open immersions and h:a≫i=b≫p, localizeSquare of the forward map of VaryingRing.moduleBeta equals, heterogeneously, the forward map of SemilinearProperOpen.beta. The equality compares the existing ordinary and derived ringed sequence-site presentations and makes no use of finite evaluation. Definitions and operations are those of [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows], [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons], [def-sf-ambient-exact-clopen-data].

source.place: Tag 0F7B (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open), map normalization; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A7 (remark-base-change), adjunction transpose. Agent exact-localization comparison for the stated ambient categories; returned proof Step 6.

proof.text:
The two ordinary pushforwards are equal because their coefficient ring maps
agree on every sequence-site object. Thus their chosen inverse images, open extensions
and adjunctions agree. The section-normalized direct-image compositors agree by their
uniqueness, so the pullback square compositor agrees after exact localization.
The inverse module beta is characterized by the open-unit equation. Exact localization
preserves that equation and the specified open adjunction; injectivity of its Hom
bijection identifies the localized inverse beta with the intrinsic inverse beta.
Taking inverses yields the displayed equality.

theorem system_beta_localized
    (C : ℕ → CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, C (n + 1) ⟶ C n)
    {U' U X' X : Scheme.{u}} (a : U' ⟶ U) (b : U' ⟶ X')
    (i : U ⟶ X) (p : X' ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion b]
    (h : a ≫ i = b ≫ p) (sq : IsPullback a b i p) :
    HEq (localizeSquare _ _ _ _ (VaryingRing.moduleBeta C τ a b i p h sq).hom)
      (SemilinearProperOpen.beta C τ a b i p h sq).hom
